messages:
sara: Quick kickoff for the landing refresh — single-page flow that surfaces Hosted / Dedicated / Private and routes leads properly. Goal: minimal copy, clear routing.
cal: Agree. priority is clarity > cleverness. Keep hero CTAs to 2 words if possible.
rachel: For benchmarking callouts let's do micro-statements: "p50 latency: ~60ms (typical)" and "Unit cost reduced via batching & cache" with a CTA to full report. No raw $ numbers.
tom: Routing matrix proposal: Hosted -> sign-up + trial email; Dedicated -> calendar link to capacity consult; Private -> AE contact + compliance packet. Hidden form value `eval_mode` to capture choice.
emma: Webinar plan: 25-min platform demo (runtime, routing, fallback) + 10-min Q&A. CTA copy options: "Watch demo" / "See throughput" / "Book capacity consult". Recommend A/B test "Watch demo" vs "See throughput" on hero.
sara: Draft microcopy for review:
  Hosted hero: "Hosted API — instant model access, no infra"
  Hosted subhead: "Start with free credits, scale as you grow"
  Dedicated hero: "Reserved capacity — predictable throughput & SLAs"
  Dedicated subhead: "Configurable autoscaling and burst options"
  Private hero: "Private deployment — VPC & on‑prem options"
  Private subhead: "Customer-controlled keys and audit logs"
Thoughts?
cal: Tighten hosted subhead to "Free credits, pay-as-you-go". drop 'no infra' maybe.
rachel: Add a short benchmark snippet beneath hero: "Typical p50: 50–80ms; optimized with batching/KV cache; see full benchmarks" (link).
emma: For webinar registration, add checkbox: [ ] I9m evaluating Dedicated/Private. Use hidden field `evaluation_mode`. Example form snippet: `<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"eval_mode\" value=\"{{mode}}\">`.
tom: Asset list for launch posts: 1) hero image showing latency comparison, 2) 30s product clip focused on routing/fallback, 3) 1-page benchmark PDF. Also short engineering thread for audience.
sara: Lead routing detail: ensure marketing form maps value -> Salesforce lead owner: hosted -> Auto SDR; dedicated -> routing to capacity queue; private -> AE team. We'll include UTMs: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch.
comms-bot: Reminder: webinar scheduled 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC (ID 98321).
cal: One more: add link to evals prompt-set from pages: `/evals/onboarding-sample` so users can probe model regressions.
sara: OK I'll post the Notion draft and tag everyone. Please leave comments by EOD tomorrow so I can push copy to staging. :rocket:
